log.author: O'Neill Cowan
log.title: Putting drill — two balls, same distance
log.text: At home or at the course, 8–12 feet from the target. Place two golf balls next to each other; the goal is to hit both the exact same distance. This ensures the putter comes in square, toe and heel traveling the same speed at impact. Alternate 10 reps of the drill with 5 reps of a single ball. Ball should feel like it comes out of the center after 3–4 sets.
